modal.title: Delete my account
modal.body: This action is permanent. We will delete your profile, XP, badges, event history and health data within 72 hours. The LOPDP audit log is retained by legal obligation.

erase.legal_note: The consent audit log is pseudonymized and retained by legal obligation (LOPDP Art. 26).

v3.label: Basic profile
v3.purpose: We store your name, avatar and city to show you in the community.
v3.scope: Name, avatar, city and favorite games you enter at registration.
v3.retention: While your account is active. Deleted within 72 hours if you request erasure.
v3.share: Your public profile is visible to other community members.

v3.label: Events
v3.purpose: We store your registrations and attendance to send reminders and credit your XP.
v3.scope: Events you register for, date and location of confirmed attendance.
v3.retention: 12 months from the event. You can revoke at any time.
v3.share: Event organizers see your name on the attendee list.

v3.label: Health logs
v3.purpose: We store what you manually enter: steps, sleep hours, mood and challenge photos.
v3.scope: Only what you write or photograph. We do not access sensors without explicit permission.
v3.retention: 90 days for detailed logs; daily summaries while your account is active.
v3.share: Only you see your health data. Anonymous summaries in aggregate studies (k≥50) if you enable B2B permissions.

v3.label: Wearable / tracker
v3.purpose: We connect your device to count steps, heart rate, sleep and calories in your character.
v3.scope: Data your device sends via Open Wearables (Garmin, Fitbit, Polar, Whoop, Oura). We do not access your account directly.
v3.retention: Samples: 90 days. Daily summaries while your account is active. Revoking stops data immediately.
v3.share: Only you see your detailed data. Anonymous summaries in aggregate studies (k≥50) if you enable B2B permissions.

v3.label: Gaming habits
v3.purpose: We analyze what you play and how often to connect you with like-minded gamers and personalize challenges.
v3.scope: Titles you declare, platforms and play frequency. We do not read your Steam or console history.
v3.share: Never individual. Only anonymous segment summaries (k≥50) for B2B if you enable that permission.

v3.label: Health insurers
v3.purpose: We share anonymous activity summaries with insurers for wellness studies.
v3.scope: Aggregate segments: activity level, event frequency. Never individual data. k≥50 minimum.
v3.retention: Only while this permission is active. Revoking removes you immediately.
v3.share: Only insurers with an active processing agreement and k≥50 guaranteed.
v3.minor_blocked: Permission not available for users under 18.

v3.label: Healthcare providers
v3.purpose: We share anonymous summaries with clinics and hospitals for habits research.
v3.scope: Aggregated activity and wellness segments (k≥50). No individual identification.
v3.retention: Only while this permission is active.
v3.share: Only providers with an active agreement. k≥50 guaranteed.
v3.minor_blocked: Permission not available for users under 18.

v3.label: Brands and sponsors
v3.purpose: We share anonymous summaries with consumer brands and telcos to improve their offers to gamers.
v3.scope: Aggregated habit and preference segments (k≥50). No health data.
v3.retention: Only while this permission is active.
v3.share: Only brands with an active agreement. k≥50 guaranteed. No health data ever.
v3.minor_blocked: Permission not available for users under 18.

v3.label: Processing outside Ecuador
v3.purpose: Your data is processed on Google servers in São Paulo, Brazil. Firebase has no Ecuador region.
v3.scope: All your platform data passes through servers in Brazil (southamerica-east1). Documented in our DPIA.
v3.retention: While your account is active. Deleted from the server within 72 hours upon account deletion.
v3.share: Google Cloud Platform (infrastructure provider). Google has no access to your content data.
v3.minor_blocked: Permission not available for users under 18.

v3.label: Academic research
v3.purpose: You participate in ethics-board-approved (IRB) academic studies on wellness and gaming.
v3.scope: Anonymous activity and habit summaries (k≥50). Only IRB-verified studies.
v3.retention: For the study period, maximum 24 months. Informed before each study.
v3.share: Only study researchers with institutional approval.
v3.minor_blocked: Permission not available for users under 18.
